inferred.x-sdem-reasoning: AID writes the records a workspace is missing into its real layer files, so an architect works in one set of files. A record SDEM inferred must never be mistaken for one a person wrote or confirmed: the mark carries the source, reasoning and confidence, and stays — with who confirmed it — once a person agrees.

http_method.description: the HTTP method of the operation, where it is not derivable or the bank overrides BIAN

x-sdem-source.standard: BIAN Semantic API Practitioner Guide v8.1 (public)
x-sdem-source.locator: §3.5 p.52 (HTTP methods used: GET, PUT, POST, PATCH, DELETE) and p.55 (Retrieve maps to GET; the other action terms become resource nouns)

http_method.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which HTTP method should an API implementing this operation use? The guide names the HTTP methods BIAN uses (p.52) and states only Retrieve → GET explicitly (p.55); the other action terms become resource nouns, so their method comes from BIAN's published Semantic API definitions (not checked here). Allowed values checked in the public guide. Approved as optional: the engine derives the method where it can (DV-A2-02); the attribute records the method where it cannot, or a deliberate override.
